tokenize_text: tokenize a string of text into a list of tokens using the regex-based tokenizer
detokenize_tokens: detokenize a list of tokens back into a string with proper punctuation spacing
split_words_on_whitespace: split text into separate lists of words and whitespace elements for later rejoining
rejoin_words_and_whitespace: rejoin a list of words and whitespace back into the original text string
get_aug_idxes: get augmentation indices for tokens using an nlpaug augmenter with priority word support
